name: paperpilot-research-workflow
description: Codex plugin and skill for applying PaperPilot's human-guided economics and finance research workflow with companion AI-for-economics-and-finance skill routing.

interface.shortDescription: Guide one finance or economics paper with PaperPilot.
interface.longDescription: Apply PaperPilot's human-guided workflow for serious economics and finance research: idea screening, question formation, literature positioning, data-permission planning, empirical design, analysis outputs, claim discipline, writing revision, reviewer stress tests, AFA-style documentation, multi-agent coordination, and journal-quality scoring. The skill also asks when to apply relevant companion patterns from AI for Economics and Finance Research, including task routing, verification, agent setup, data construction, text-as-data measurement, empirical-methods audits, and disclosure checks.
defaultPrompt: Use PaperPilot to start a research paper workflow.
Apply relevant AI-for-econ-finance skills in PaperPilot.
Run PaperPilot from the current stage to final review.
